name: Nicrosil
description: The Coppermind's toolkit: verify or reject drafts with one click, a review queue sidebar, flag resolving, hotkeys, a Dashboard with a live search box and a home button, a collapsible properties strip, a button that logs schema changes, a monthly log archive, an atlas of the wiki's topics, Connections, a folding section on each page that maps its links, a transcription queue that checks scans of handwritten notes against their transcriptions, a query mode in the Dashboard's search bar that asks Claude Code and saves answers to Analyses, and a Triage dashboard that ingests sources from Ingestion/Raw through Claude Code, and Claude-drafted transcriptions in the transcription queue. Updates the page, index.md, and log.md.
author: Harrison Nickles
